overrides: Current host binaries/units and public QEMU runtime overlaid in laboratory RAM.
Production gateway image; session guest has the production token receiver and launcher plus an unprivileged synthetic probe.
Host service stderr is enabled only in the volatile laboratory journal.

order: Check gateway readiness before unlocking session volume.
Generate local token and prepare the private Ethernet socket; no broker grant yet.
Launch QEMU with vCPUs paused and connect the private token channel.
Host gateway owner checks the console peer UID 1100 and obtains SO_PEERPIDFD; it closes the console connection before the manager attaches.
Only after acquiring the process handle, authorize the API broker; then resume the guest and deliver the token.
mechanism.monitor: Kernel pidfd, close-on-exec, polled in the existing owner loop; no caller-supplied numeric PID, new persisted state or new service.
mechanism.exit: On readability/hangup revoke the broker, verify the supervisor reports inactive and release the pidfd. A control error terminates the owner and destroys the gateway VM.
mechanism.normal_close: Explicit revoke drops the process handle before QEMU/storage closure.
mechanism.storage: The observer never declares the vault locked. Direct controller use remains interlocked until explicit close; the trusted manager follows its existing console-exit close path.
mechanism.latency: Ordinary owner loop interval is 250 ms; IPC work adds delay. Instantaneous revocation is not claimed.
mechanism.kernel_requirement: SO_PEERPIDFD, Linux 6.5+ on supported x86_64/aarch64; tested on the Debian 6.12 laboratory kernel. Missing support rejects startup before token delivery.

pidfd_assertions: The host owner holds a close-on-exec pidfd whose fdinfo PID is the actual session QEMU PID.
SIGKILL of that QEMU causes the existing owner to report an inactive broker and release the pidfd without prior storage close/revoke.
The session LUKS mapping remains open and a new enter is refused until explicit close.
QMP quit causes the same automatic revocation on another opening.
verification.revocation_observation: Private host Check forwards a supervisor status request and validates its inactive state; the supervisor acknowledges revoke only after the API child has exited. This suite does not observe a live provider stream.
